definitions.explanation: Having a small diameter or width.
Having a delicate or refined quality.

examples.japanese: この{道|みち}は{細|ほそ}い。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{細|ほそ}い{体|からだ}をしている。

notes:
{細|ほそ}い is an i-adjective meaning thin, slender, or narrow.

FORMS:
- Adverb: {細|ほそ}く
- Noun form: {細|ほそ}さ (thinness)

OPPOSITE:
{太|ふと}い (thick, fat, wide)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {道|みち}が{細|ほそ}い: narrow road
- {細|ほそ}い{指|ゆび}: slender fingers
- {細|ほそ}い{線|せん}: thin line
- {声|こえ}が{細|ほそ}い: weak/thin voice
- {目|め}が{細|ほそ}い: narrow eyes
- {細|ほそ}い{体|からだ}: slender body

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {細|ほそ}い: physically thin/narrow (objects, roads, limbs)
- {薄|うす}い: thin in thickness (paper, walls)
- {痩|や}せている: thin (body weight, person)

COMPOUND:
- {細長|ほそなが}い: long and thin
